proof_summary: Define a candidate sequence by the linear recurrence and track the defect \(D_{n+1}=a_{n+1}^2-a_na_{n+2}\); induction gives a recurrence for \(D\), positivity/growth bounds, and \(1\le D_{n+1}\le a_n\). These bounds show \(\lceil a_{n+1}^2/a_n\rceil-1=a_{n+2}\), so the original nonlinear sequence equals the linear-recurrence sequence, yielding the generating function.
